The simulator is built in `output/` and compiles with an empty `[dependencies]` table. The three examples in your spec reproduce exactly. In the longer smoke tests I only checked that the results looked plausible, and I haven't checked the arcs, cutter compensation or helical timing against hand-computed values.

The build only works if `cargo` is on the path. In this sandbox I had to add `/usr/local/cargo/bin` first.

**What I ran:**
- Example 1 (linear move), Example 2 (G81 canned cycle) and Example 3 (G43 H99 error) all match your trace output, including the error line number.
- G84 tapping emits the spindle direction flip and then the trailing restore entry at the same time.
- Other cases run without crashing: G10, G92 and G92.1 offsets, G28, G4 dwell, M30 reset, a G41 entry move and corner, G38.2 probing and `--parameter-output`.

**Where I made calls the spec doesn't settle:**
- Machine position is the physical axis position, so tool length offset is added to the commanded point. G43 on its own doesn't change the reported position.
- Unit changes convert the current position only. Offsets, tool lengths and home parameters keep their numbers.
- `parameters` is sparse. It holds what was loaded or written, such as 5211–5216 after G92, 5220 on G5x and M2/M30, and 5061–5066 after a probe.
- M2 and M30 do not clear 5211–5216, only the G92 offset itself.
- An explicit G92 offset in `--parameter-input` is not applied at start; G92.3 restores it.
- Required parameters missing from `--parameter-input` are not treated as an error. Out-of-order or out-of-range parameter numbers are.
- G38.2 only checks the tool against `--probe-tool` when you pass it.
- Spindle direction reports the commanded M3/M4, even if S is 0.
- A G82/G86/G88/G89 dwell emits an entry with no `motion_kind`.
- Default carousel size is 68 slots, and the default path mode is G64.
- Missing R on a canned cycle (with no earlier R to reuse) is an error.
- Cutter compensation is the weakest area. Concave cor
